curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Once the latch is turned, what malevolence has been released from inside the antique box?
curatedMovie.description: After an antique jack-in-the-box is unearthed and opened, its new owners begin to suspect the sinister clown doll inside harbors a dangerous life of its own.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, focused British horror that builds moderate dread at a steady pace, ideal for solo late-night viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This horror premise centers on new owners who come to believe a creepy clown doll inside a vintage jack-in-the-box has a life of its own.
